6. [LGRA.16.6] **`log` arity.**
   - **`log` takes a level.** [LGRA.10.1] reads
     `'log' log_level STRING_LIT` with `log_level` ∈
     `{debug, info, warning, error, critical}` (case-insensitive,
     mirroring Python's `logging`). The compiler normalises
     to UPPER-case in the lowered action and synthesises the
     category from the rule name (per [RLOW.7.7]).
   - The runtime log-level enum mirrors the same five names.
